info.title: OpenMSI
info.description:
Use OpenMSI CLI to create Windows Installers (*.msi) using declarative YAML files.

Deploy your application on Windows using a modern, simple, and intuitive tool.

Write Custom Actions using modern .NET to deliver professional and powerful MSI packages.

Get your fisrt *.msi in literally a couple of minutes. Check the README file to get started or visit https://openmsi.dev/documentation.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: This tool is useful for creating Windows Installers (*.msi) using declarative YAML files.

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Initializes a new OpenMSI project for you so you can immediately generate your Windows Installer (*.msi).
It usually creates a msi-package.yaml file and \msi-package directory with dialogs YAMLs and assets.
Did something different and awesome? Share your template on https://openmsi.dev/templates.
You can initialize a package project referencing a URL or an embedded template.

options.name: --argument
options.description: Initialization argument(s) requested by template. E.g.: --arg "Product Name=DemoApp" --arg "version=1.2.3"

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Show detailed output
Executed in 0.000 seconds.

arguments.name: TEMPLATE
arguments.description: The template name or URL to be used in initialization. For complete list of embedded templates run `openmsi init --help`. Default 'Welcome_Browse'.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version information
- NoUI
- Welcome
- Welcome_Browse (Default)
- Welcome_Config
- Welcome_LicenseAgreement
- Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Browse
- Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Config
- Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Config_Browse
Usage examples:
openmsi init Welcome_LicenseAgreement_Browse
openmsi init https://openmsi.dev/downloads/templates/welcome-browse.7z
preview <file>   Previews the specified MSI dialog.
Usage example:
openmsi preview WelcomeDlg --arg "MyArg1=value1"
build <file>     Builds a Windows Installer (*.msi) file from an OpenMSI project.
openmsi build
openmsi build msi-package.yaml
license          Activates an OpenMSI installation or checks the details of the current license.
openmsi license --org-id <your organization Identifier> --alias "<Maybe a host or pipeline name>"
openmsi license
